Sources

Where every number came from

Published statistics

  1. Ministry of Health and Prevention (MoHAP). UAE National Health Survey 2017 to 2018. Used for: 67.9% of adults 18 to 69 overweight or obese; 27.8% obese; women 30.6% against men 25.1%.
  2. UAE Ministry of Health, 2023. Used for: Abu Dhabi adult obesity 35.9%, Dubai 22.2%.
  3. World Obesity Federation. UAE Obesity in Numbers, 2024. Used for: US$11.67 billion cost in 2019, 2.8% of GDP rising to 4.85% by 2035; 7,622 deaths from related noncommunicable diseases; projections of 6.5 million adults and 700,000 children by 2035.
  4. World Obesity Federation. United Arab Emirates: Obesity in Numbers, 2024, drawing on the Global School-Based Student Health Survey 2016 and the UAE National Health Survey 2017 to 2018. Used for: 38.4% of 13 to 17 year olds overweight or obese, obesity in 21.1% of boys against 12.3% of girls.
  5. Al Hajeri, O. M. and Al Hammadi, O. Obesity in the UAE, in Healthcare in the United Arab Emirates, 2026, citing the UAE National Health Survey 2017 to 2018. Used for: 41.8% of Emirati women estimated to have obesity, against 30.6% of women in the UAE overall.
  6. National Institute of Diabetes and Digestive and Kidney Diseases. Health Risks of Overweight & Obesity. Used for: the definition of obesity and its related conditions.

My own fieldwork

  1. Pedestrian counts, Mohammed Bin Zayed City, from beside UAE JJ to the Mahawi roundabout, several evenings between 6 and 10 pm, early September 2026. 11 to 12 people an evening, 11 of the 12 counted were men.
  2. Treadmill counts, Warehouse Gym, Yas Bay, peak hour from 6 pm, early September 2026. Over 30 people in one hour, all 18 treadmills in use, 12 of 18 were women.
  3. Supermarket observation and photograph, Lulu, September 2026.
  4. Social media poll run on my own account, September 2026. 200 votes.
  5. Testimonial conversation recorded in September 2026.
  6. Map imagery: Google Maps, Mohammed Bin Zayed City, retrieved September 2026. Map data © Google.
  7. My own records: MyFitnessPal logs, Whoop data, and my weight history from 80kg at 150cm.
